label: Verbs of breaking or shattering in languages other than English, literal or figurative: Spanish romper (rompieron, rompió), French casser (cassé, casse) and déchirer, Portuguese quebrar, Italian rompere (rotto), German zerbrechen, Arabic كسر; also English smash, shatter, burst. Also fires on words built on those stems with another meaning (Spanish 'rompecabezas', Arabic كسر as the vowel name). English break/broke fires only weakly. Quiet for crack, cut, split, bend, open, repair, and for the noun 'coffee break'.
